object_entity.proposition_label: The succession of bishops in their see guarantees the apostolic faith
object_entity.description: The see of the bishop, transmitted through orderly succession, is the locus and guarantee of the faith received from the apostles.

passage.excerpt: Appoint for yourselves bishops and deacons worthy of the Lord, gentle men who are not fond of money, truthful and tested; for they also perform for you the service of the prophets and teachers. Do not despise them, for they are your honorable men together with the prophets and teachers.
passage.notes: Mandate to appoint bishops and deacons; episcopal/diaconal ministry set on par with prophets and teachers

object_entity.proposition_label: The Eucharist fulfills Malachi's prophecy of the pure offering in every place
object_entity.description: The Christian Eucharist is identified as the fulfillment of Malachi 1:11 — the pure sacrifice offered to God in every place throughout the nations.

passage.excerpt: On the Lord's Day come together, break bread, hold Eucharist after confessing transgressions so offering may be pure. Let none with quarrel join until reconciled, that sacrifice not be defiled. In every place and time offer me a pure sacrifice.
passage.notes: Sunday eucharist with sacrifice language and reconciliation requirement

evidence.notes: Didache 9:1-5 provides the eucharistic context for the Malachi typology in ch.14.

passage.excerpt: Eucharist thanksgiving over cup (holy vine of David) and broken bread (life and knowledge through Jesus). Let none eat or drink except those baptized in the Lord's name.
